title: Seedling Swap returns to the quayside
text: After a year's pause, the Fernhaven Seed Library's Seedling Swap returned to the quayside on Saturday. The library, founded in 2014 by retired schoolteacher Maren Odell, lends seed free of charge from the former lifeboat station on Quay Street, and the swap is its biggest day of the year. Tables of tomato and squash seedlings were cleared out before noon.
